title.narrative: Second Tashkent Province Water Supply Development Project

description.narrative: The project will support the Government of Uzbekistan in the rehabilitation and expansion of a regional water supply system located in the Yangiyul and Chinaz districts of Tashkent province. Responding directly to the water supply shortage of the population in the project area, it will improve water supply and sanitation services, pilot the decentralized wastewater disposal systems, and strengthen institutional capacity in the province's water supply and wastewater utility. The project is listed in the Asian Development Bank (ADB) country operations business plan for Uzbekistan, 2019-2021.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3782: 59% of contracts awarded and 48% disbursed as of 17 Mar 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: To be determined.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51240/51240-001-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51240/51240-001-rp-en_8.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51240/51240-001-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Two work contracts physically completed: (a) Rehabilitation of Wellfield VU-1 (Construction of Water Intake Structure VU-1); and (b) Construction and Rehabilitation of Transmission Mains from VU-1 to VU-3. Four works contracts are ongoing implementation. Two works contracts are still to be awarded. Capacity building activities are yet to commence. Advertisement of consultant requirements will be posted within March 2024.
